agent_pair: --machine and --session must be non-empty and supplied together
create_usage:
usage: personad create-direction <name> --project <slug> [--machine <machine-id> --session <session-id>]
  exit: 0 created (leader JSON printed), 1 failed, 2 usage / invalid, 4 unavailable, 130 interrupted
progress_required: at least one of --reached, --doing and --needs-you is required
write_usage:
usage: personad write-progress <direction-id> [--reached <text>] [--doing <text>] [--needs-you <text>] [--link <url> ...]
  exit: 0 written (leader JSON printed), 1 failed, 2 usage / invalid, 4 unavailable, 130 interrupted
